name: pets-council
description: A Codex workspace with a consultative council of living companions.

petsCouncil.codexBinary.description: Optional path to the Codex CLI binary. Falls back to CODEX_BIN, then codex on PATH.

petsCouncil.petMotion.description: Controls companion animation. System follows the operating-system reduced-motion preference.

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test dist/context.test.js dist/evidence.test.js dist/mockCouncil.test.js dist/webview.test.js dist/council/provider.test.js dist/memory/contextGraph.test.js dist/pets/petPack.test.js dist/runtime/jsonl.test.js dist/runtime/client.test.js dist/runtime/service.test.js dist/runtime/councilBridge.test.js dist/runtime/sessionStore.test.js
